brandPositioningSummary: City Express by Marriott is a CALA-relevant midscale select-service Marriott family within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is regional business travel, efficient operations, conversion or new-build fit, Marriott platform participation, and CALA footprint relevance. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton.
ownerFitSummary: regional business travel, efficient operations, conversion or new-build fit, Marriott platform participation, and CALA footprint relevance
propertyFitSummary: midscale urban, airport, and secondary-city hotels across Mexico and broader Latin America with efficient operating models

scenarios.title: CALA midscale new-build
scenarios.summary: A Mexico or broader CALA midscale site where owners want Marriott Bonvoy distribution with an efficient operating model. City Express fits when guest expectations center on consistency, location, and value rather than lifestyle-select design. Owners should diligence whether City Express by Marriott is a better fit than Courtyard by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Airport or business-district conversion
scenarios.summary: A conversion near airports or business districts across Mexico and Latin America. Diligence should confirm product family (City Express / Plus / Junior / Centro), systems requirements, and operating staffing assumptions. Owners should diligence whether City Express by Marriott is a better fit than Courtyard by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Portfolio expansion in existing City Express markets
scenarios.summary: Owners adding inventory where City Express already has guest recognition. Compare local comps, territory, and whether Courtyard or Fairfield would over- or under-specify the asset. Owners should diligence whether City Express by Marriott is a better fit than Courtyard by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
